title: Wings live: City Hall, Newcastle upon Tyne | 1979
content:
Wings performed at the City Hall in Newcastle upon Tyne, England, on 14 December 1979.

It was the 16th night of the 19-date Wings UK Tour 1979.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, bass guitar, and keyboards; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Laurence Juber on guitar; and Steve Holley on drums, plus a horns and brass section consisting of Howie Casey, Tony Dorsey, Steve Howard, and Thaddeus Richard.

The Beatles had performed at Newcastle’s City Hall on 23 March, 8 June, and 23 November 1963, and 4 December 1965. Wings had previously played there on 10 July 1973 and 16 September 1975.
